package runtimeproof_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"encoding/pem"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/zhangzhe-ctrl/ani-modeldev-service/internal/biz"
	"github.com/zhangzhe-ctrl/ani-modeldev-service/internal/data/execution"
	"github.com/zhangzhe-ctrl/ani-modeldev-service/internal/data/lifecycle"
	"github.com/zhangzhe-ctrl/ani-modeldev-service/internal/data/trainer"
	abe "github.com/zhangzhe-ctrl/ani-modeldev-service/scripts/legacy-modeldev-data-cleanup/originalabe"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured"
	"k8s.io/client-go/dynamic"
	"k8s.io/client-go/rest"
)

func originalABEPending(t *testing.T, accessMode ...string) (*computeCleanupFixture, biz.OperationRecord, dynamic.Interface, *int) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	f := newComputeCleanupClosingFixture(t, false, "USER_STOP")
	observer := &configuredCleanupObserver{TrainingRuntime: trainer.New(f.kube), err: biz.ErrRuntimeNotReady}
	f.step.proof.WithTrainingRuntime(observer)
	result, e := f.worker(t).ReconcileOnce(ctx)
	if e != nil || result.Unresolved != 1 {
		t.Fatal("real initial owner close/StepExit", e)
	}
	pool := f.step.open()
	repo := lifecycle.New(pool)
	state, e := repo.GetRuntime(ctx, f.step.f.execution.TenantID, f.step.f.execution.ExecutionID)
	if e != nil || state.StepExitCleanup.CompletedAt == nil {
		t.Fatal("real completed step exit", e)
	}
	observer.err = nil
	logs, e := f.step.proof.CaptureComputeCleanupLogs(ctx, f.step.f.execution, f.step.f.authority(), state)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("original durable training log qualification", e)
	}
	state, e = repo.RecordComputeCleanupLogs(ctx, f.step.f.authority(), state.CloseGeneration, logs)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	state, e = repo.RecordComputeCleanupResult(ctx, f.step.f.authority(), state.CloseGeneration, 1, nil, "BLOCKED")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for i := uint32(2); i <= 3; i++ {
		state, e = repo.StartComputeCleanupAttempt(ctx, f.step.f.authority(), state.CloseGeneration)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		state, e = repo.RecordComputeCleanupResult(ctx, f.step.f.authority(), state.CloseGeneration, i, nil, "BLOCKED")
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	record, e := execution.New(pool).GetOperationRecord(ctx, f.step.f.execution.TenantID, f.step.f.execution.ExecutionID)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = abe.Qualify(record); e != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual exhausted+captured original receipt", e)
	}
	f.workflowDeleted = true
	// The external peer provides API resourceVersion, unlike the earlier minimal
	// fixture list/PVC responses. No domain or persistence behavior is replaced.
	calls := new(int)
	peer := httptest.NewTLSServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		*calls++
		if r.Method != "GET" || strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/log") {
			t.Error("maintenance attempted a mutation/log read", r.Method, r.URL.Path)
			w.WriteHeader(405)
			return
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/workflows") {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"apiVersion":"argoproj.io/v1alpha1","kind":"WorkflowList","metadata":{"resourceVersion":"fixture-rv-1"},"items":[]}`))
			return
		}
		rr := httptest.NewRecorder()
		f.step.serve(t, rr, r)
		res := rr.Result()
		raw, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
		_ = res.Body.Close()
		if res.StatusCode == 200 {
			var obj map[string]any
			if json.Unmarshal(raw, &obj) == nil {
				meta, _ := obj["metadata"].(map[string]any)
				if meta == nil {
					meta = map[string]any{}
					obj["metadata"] = meta
				}
				if obj["kind"] == "PersistentVolumeClaim" {
					obj["spec"] = map[string]any{"storageClassName": record.Execution.Snapshot.Workspace.StorageClass, "accessModes": []string{func() string {
						if len(accessMode) > 0 {
							return accessMode[0]
						}
						return "ReadWriteOnce"
					}()}, "resources": map[string]any{"requests": map[string]any{"storage": fmt.Sprint(record.Execution.Snapshot.Workspace.CapacityBytes)}}}
				}
				if meta["resourceVersion"] == nil {
					meta["resourceVersion"] = "fixture-rv-1"
				}
				raw, _ = json.Marshal(obj)
			}
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(res.StatusCode)
		_, _ = w.Write(raw)
	}))
	t.Cleanup(peer.Close)
	cfg := &rest.Config{Host: peer.URL, TLSClientConfig: rest.TLSClientConfig{CAData: pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: peer.Certificate().Raw})}, QPS: 500, Burst: 500}
	kube, e := dynamic.NewForConfig(cfg)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return f, record, kube, calls
}
func TestOriginalABEMaintenanceRealCloserKeepsThreeAttempts(t *testing.T) {
	f, record, kube, calls := originalABEPending(t, "ReadWriteMany")
	ctx := context.Background()
	beforeReads := f.logReads
	plan, e := abe.Inspect(ctx, kube, record)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("read-only original delete plan", e)
	}
	present := 0
	for _, v := range plan.Targets {
		if v.Present {
			present++
			if v.DeleteOptions == nil || v.DeleteOptions.Preconditions == nil || v.DeleteOptions.Preconditions.UID == nil || v.DeleteOptions.Preconditions.ResourceVersion == nil {
				t.Fatal("unconditional operator delete")
			}
		}
	}
	if present != 6 || !plan.NoCurrentWriters || plan.Workspace.UID != f.step.workspace.PVCUID {
		t.Fatal("original six targets/PVC", present)
	}
	pool := f.step.open()
	if _, e = abe.Observe(ctx, pool, kube, plan); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("present original target accepted")
	}
	unchanged, e := execution.New(pool).GetOperationRecord(ctx, record.Execution.TenantID, record.Execution.ExecutionID)
	if e != nil || abe.SourceSHA(unchanged) != abe.SourceSHA(record) {
		t.Fatal("blocked observation mutated source", e)
	}
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.objects = nil
	f.runtimeDeleted = true
	f.mu.Unlock()
	f.step.mu.Lock()
	f.step.pods = map[string]*unstructured.Unstructured{}
	f.step.mu.Unlock()
	changedPVC := plan
	changedPVC.Workspace.SpecSHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	if _, e = abe.Observe(ctx, pool, kube, changedPVC); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed reviewed PVC spec accepted")
	}
	after, e := abe.Observe(ctx, pool, kube, plan)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("real Closer absence CAS", e)
	}
	if after.ComputeCleanup.Phase != "APPLIED" || after.ComputeCleanup.Attempts != 3 || after.ComputeCleanup.OperatorRetry != nil || len(after.ComputeCleanup.ConfirmedAbsent) != 7 || !reflect.DeepEqual(record.Runtime.ComputeCleanup.Logs, after.ComputeCleanup.Logs) || !reflect.DeepEqual(record.Runtime.CloseEvidence, after.CloseEvidence) || f.logReads != beforeReads || len(f.deleted) != 0 || *calls == 0 {
		t.Fatal("original attempt/exits/logs changed or boundary mutated")
	}
}
func TestOriginalABEMaintenanceRejectsChangedEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	f, record, kube, _ := originalABEPending(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	plan, e := abe.Inspect(ctx, kube, record)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for _, mode := range []string{"missing log", "fourth attempt", "changed generation", "changed UID", "changed source"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			raw, _ := json.Marshal(record)
			var changed biz.OperationRecord
			_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &changed)
			switch mode {
			case "missing log":
				changed.Runtime.ComputeCleanup.Logs = nil
			case "fourth attempt":
				changed.Runtime.ComputeCleanup.Attempts = 4
			case "changed generation":
				changed.Runtime.CloseGeneration++
			case "changed UID":
				changed.Runtime.ComputeCleanup.Targets[0].UID = "replacement"
			case "changed source":
				plan.SourceSHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
			}
			if mode == "changed source" {
				if _, e := abe.Observe(ctx, f.step.open(), kube, plan); e == nil {
					t.Fatal("changed reviewed source accepted")
				}
			} else if abe.Qualify(changed) == nil {
				t.Fatal("changed original qualification accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	after, e := execution.New(f.step.open()).GetOperationRecord(ctx, record.Execution.TenantID, record.Execution.ExecutionID)
	if e != nil || abe.SourceSHA(after) != abe.SourceSHA(record) || len(f.deleted) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("negative proof mutated original receipt", e)
	}
}

func TestOriginalABEMaintenanceRejectsLiveBoundaryDrift(t *testing.T) {
	f, record, kube, _ := originalABEPending(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	var trainPath string
	for path, o := range f.objects {
		if o.GetKind() == "TrainJob" {
			trainPath = path
		}
	}
	originalTrain := f.objects[trainPath].DeepCopy()
	for _, mode := range []string{"replacement target UID", "resumed original controller", "PVC in GC closure", "unrelated current PVC writer", "unknown target read"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			oldServe := f.step.serveExtra
			switch mode {
			case "replacement target UID":
				f.objects[trainPath].SetUID("replacement-train")
			case "resumed original controller":
				_ = unstructured.SetNestedField(f.objects[trainPath].Object, false, "spec", "suspend")
			case "PVC in GC closure":
				f.pvcOwnerUID = "train-original"
			case "unrelated current PVC writer":
				f.step.pods["foreign-current-writer"] = &unstructured.Unstructured{Object: map[string]any{"apiVersion": "v1", "kind": "Pod", "metadata": map[string]any{"name": "foreign-current-writer", "namespace": record.Authority.NamespaceName, "uid": "foreign-writer-uid", "resourceVersion": "1"}, "spec": map[string]any{"volumes": []any{map[string]any{"name": "workspace", "persistentVolumeClaim": map[string]any{"claimName": f.step.workspace.PVCName}}}, "containers": []any{map[string]any{"name": "foreign"}}}}}
			case "unknown target read":
				f.step.serveExtra = func(t *testing.T, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
					if r.URL.Path == trainPath {
						w.WriteHeader(503)
						_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"kind":"Status","apiVersion":"v1","reason":"ServiceUnavailable","code":503}`))
						return true
					}
					return oldServe(t, w, r)
				}
			}
			if _, e := abe.Inspect(ctx, kube, record); e == nil {
				t.Fatal("live identity/writer uncertainty accepted", mode)
			}
			f.objects[trainPath] = originalTrain.DeepCopy()
			f.pvcOwnerUID = ""
			delete(f.step.pods, "foreign-current-writer")
			f.step.serveExtra = oldServe
			after, e := execution.New(f.step.open()).GetOperationRecord(ctx, record.Execution.TenantID, record.Execution.ExecutionID)
			if e != nil || abe.SourceSHA(after) != abe.SourceSHA(record) || len(f.deleted) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("negative boundary probe mutated original source", e)
			}
		})
	}
}
